220000.description:
Elizabeth, a villainess whose poor social skills kept her from escaping condemnation, is chosen as a sacrifice to the Demon King. On the verge of being eaten, she shouts out the dream she couldn't fulfill in her previous life, becoming a chef: "Eat my cooking!" In the Demon King's castle, where not a single crop will grow, she is assigned to an "employee cafeteria" on the brink of closing! She resolves to win over the stomachs of the inscrutable Demon King and the fearsome demons with knowledge from her past life and warm food. But just when things seem to be going well, radicals who hate humans stand in her way...?

A demon-world gourmet fantasy in which a socially awkward young lady devoted to cooking starts a revolution through the stomach!

(Source: Corona EX, translated)

title.native: 魔王城の絶品社食、作っているのは生贄です！@COMIC
title.romaji: Maou-jou no Zeppin Shashoku, Tsukutte Iru no wa Ikenie desu! @COMIC

220001.description:
The year is 20xx. The Japanese government, struggling with labor shortages, creates highly intelligent life forms called "Cobitons." A pilot program begins in City S, using them as labor replacements and family members. The Cobitons function smoothly and prove useful to the people. However, an unprecedented earthquake strikes the region, rendering them uncontrollable. They begin to run amok, unleashing a horrific slaughter. In this desperate situation, college student Jinya rises up to fight for survival! A groundbreaking survival suspense story!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

220002.description:
"I finally managed to get it all the way in!" In a world where beastfolk and humans coexist peacefully, Hinako is a human woman married to the aloof wolfman Soshiro through an arranged marriage. Unsure how to bridge the distance between them, she takes a bold step and applies for "mating leave," paid time off meant to accommodate a beastfolk's mating period. Summoning all her courage, she tells Soshiro that she wants to spend a passionate night in his arms. In response, he bares the fangs he had always kept hidden and says, "I've been holding back all this time, so you'd better prepare yourself." With that, he unleashes a fiery passion beyond anything she had ever dreamed of. "No way, it's getting even bigger!"

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Mating Leave: My Beastman Husband's Insatiable Rut
title.native: 交配休暇~獣人夫の本気の発情が止まらない
title.romaji: Kouhai Kyuuka: Juujin Otto no Honki no Hatsujou ga Tomaranai

220003.description:
Toa was reincarnated as the second son of a noble family while retaining memories of his life on Earth. Although he aimed for a leisurely and comfortable life in another world, he was exiled to a border fort at a young age due to his lack of talent in swordsmanship and magic. Ten years later, following his father’s death, he was called back only to be disowned by his older brother, Grass, who had inherited the family. Undaunted by these harsh circumstances, Toa decided to use the skills and knowledge he acquired at the border fort to become an adventurer. However, after helping a girl named Nikka during the guild’s entrance exam, he becomes entangled in an incident that shakes the royal capital–!? The exhilarating battle fantasy begins, where those who underestimate him will pay double!

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

title.native: 放逐された転生貴族は、自由にやらせてもらいます
title.romaji: Houchiku Sareta Tensei Kizoku wa, Jiyuu ni Yarasete Moraimasu

220005.description:
Despite his tough-guy appearance, Spinel is a rough-and-tumble man who absolutely loves "cute things." Having been imprisoned for certain reasons, he decides to start a new life surrounded by "cute things" upon his release. Together with a fluffy beast he meets in town and a girl from the legendary "Celestial Race," he plans to run a cute "Fluffy Cafe" in his second life—or so he thought, but hard-hitting troubles keep piling up in his lap...!?

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

title.native: そのもふカフェ店主、元・最凶海賊。
title.romaji: Sono Mofu Café Tenshu, Moto Saikyou Kaizoku.

title.native: ダイヤのB!! 青道高校吹奏楽部 act2

220007.description:
Amid a war between Earth and Jupiter's forces, our protagonist is captured by the enemy while piloting the "Acephale." Refusing to become a prisoner of war, what will he do next...?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: ノー・マンズ・サテライト

220008.description:
The newest "great detective" of this era is born!! The first official manga adaptation of Hundred Note!! Hercule Poirot, Kogoro Akechi, Sherlock Holmes. Whenever a crime is committed, you can count on a great detective being there. This is the story of the birth of a new great detective.

The year is 20XX. In TOKYO CITY, 100 "great detectives" work under the unified detective organization, Nest, to solve cases. Daichi Tenmei is a high school student whose father was a great detective who also dreams of becoming a great detective himself. Together with Jin Shiba, who posses extraordinary perception and deductive reasoning skills, and Tatehito Kiri, a smug Kansai native who lives for flattery but also cares deeply for his friends, the three travel to a deserted island. However, a single scream turns what was supposed to be a fun trip with classmates into a tragedy.

title.native: ハンドレッドノートー高校生探偵　天命大地ー
title.romaji: Hundred Note: High School Detective Tenmei Daichi

220011.description:
[If you could only choose one person to live your ideal life with, which would you choose?] Chiho loves her job, and Natsu loves Chiho very much. They are both 156cm tall. They were supposed to be the best of friends because they were the same height, but lately Chiho has been feeling a little cramped when she's with Natsu... Just as Chiho is worried that she might not be able to stay with Natsu anymore, something happens that solves all her worries...!?

(Source: Gentosha Comics, translated)

220020.description:
Sakae Itou, a boy captivated by paintings with a unique color palette, meets Kiyoko Sugano—the artist behind a mural in Shinjuku—and finds himself swept up by her distinctive personality… Drawn to Kiyoko, who earnestly declares, “I want to change the world,” Sakae follows her lead and enrolls in a prestigious high school. He then abandons the path that would have secured his future (the respectable art club) and joins a shady club called the Contemporary Art Research Society, where the future looks bleak...? While being pulled along by the woman he admires, he revels in freedom, anguish, and sex among a group of outcasts who couldn’t fit into society. A Johanne Yamamoto-style, left-wing, coming-of-age story!

(Source: Group Zero, translated)

220021.description:
Having the person you like by your side makes every day a little more special.

There's the kind and tall official and Kozakura Men, who adores him. Even the fleeting moments when they notice the height difference, the juice they share from the vending machine during lunch break, or the moments when their eyes meet during a long-distance run—these are all precious moments for the two of them.

Even the cool and aloof Hitsuji-chan, when she's alone with her boyfriend Tomo-kun, shares one earphone or secretly peeks at his sleeping face. There's also the yuri couple Aoi and Yoru, who nurture their love in the classroom, and the mischievous underclassman Ama and the stoic senior Kokoro-senpai, and various other couples who blush, get anxious, and get close...

A school romantic comedy that captures the ordinary yet special everyday moments spent with the person you like!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 綿ちゃんたちは恋してる。
白衣の天秤-士道冴子の医療訴訟録-

220028.description:
"Marry me." A political marriage with her childhood friend, with divorce as the inevitable outcome...!?

Aoi is ordered to marry her childhood friend, Togo, in place of her sister who ran away just before their arranged marriage. Togo was Aoi's secret first love, but Togo loves her sister. Confused but accepting for the sake of her family, Aoi tries to accept the marriage. She intends to live as a couple in name only, but the purpose of the political marriage is to produce an heir...!?

(Source: HarperCollinsJapan, translated)

title.native: 身ごもったら、この結婚は終わりにしましょう～身代わり花嫁はＳ系弁護士の溺愛に毎夜甘く啼かされる～

220060.description:
A special membership to the Erebos Hotel, inherited from his mother, who passed away ten years ago. Jess, who wanted to draw the monsters that appeared in his dreams, enters the hotel with high hopes. However, amid bizarre rules and a series of disappearances, the hotel gradually descends into a labyrinth. Amid the chaos, Jess finds himself helplessly drawn to Caiman, a man who is both kind and dangerous.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

220061.description: Note: The second story in Lezhin's Hole Sweet Hole Danpyeonseon (홀스윗홀 단편선) Collection.

220062.description: Note: The third story in Lezhin's Hole Sweet Hole Danpyeonseon (홀스윗홀 단편선) Collection.

[Hole Sweet Hole Anthology] The Loser Gets the Bottom?

220069.description:
When I woke up, I found myself in the world of a romance game as the childhood friend heroine, Suzuna Ametsuki. And the one who appeared before me was lazy, spoiled protagonist… Honestly, I don’t like him. I have no experience with romance, but being the one he’s trying to win over is a bit of a problem. In that case, I’ll just keep breaking romance flags until I’m demoted to a background character.

I’ll leave dating the protagonist to the other girls… Wait, heroine? Aren’t you a little to close? Our skin is touching, and I can even hear your breathing. Um… I’m not your love interest, okay? (Source: no9, translated)

Note: self-published version of Osananajimi no Watashi wa Mob de Itai Noni, Naze ka Heroine no Renai Taishou ni Natteiru. after the manga serialization was cancelled.

220070.description:
Yukiya Tojo is reincarnated into another world by a self-proclaimed “god” and begins a self-sufficient, slow-paced life with help from Gre, a talking spider. But just as he’s settling in, an elf woman wearing revealing, sexy clothes pays him a visit…!?

A cultural exchange begins with a demi-human girl with a wildly lecherous nature!

(Source: Comic Walker, translated)
synonyms: Harem Life With Lewd Demon Girls

title.native: ドスケベ魔族とハーレムライフ

220071.description:
Yukiya Tojo took his own life after losing all hope, but a self-proclaimed “god” reincarnated him into another world, where he began living a slow-paced life in a cabin deep in the woods. As he went about his daily life, with help from a talking spider…,

“A human… a man…?”

A woman of striking beauty — visible even through her veil — and wearing revealing, sexy clothing came to visit him…!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: ドスケベ魔族が蔓延る異世界でスローライフを送ろうとしたら、 なぜか知らぬ間に魔王軍の美人幹部たちに気に入られて毎日種付けエッチをするハーレムライフになっていました。
title.romaji: Dosukebe Mazoku ga Habikoru Isekai de Slow Life wo Okurou to Shitara, Naze ka Shiranumani Maougun no Bijin Kanbutachi ni Kiniirarete Mainichi Tanetsuke Ecchi wo Suru Harem Life ni Natte Imashita.

220072.description:
Hirano Fumika, a woman in her late twenties who's been dumped by her boyfriend after being overwhelmed by her demanding job, unexpectedly meets Makoto Sora, a member of the group "Tonari" (Next Door) to her favorite idol, Hasumi Ryusei! She reaches out to him, who's on hiatus due to a scandal and suffering from an illness, and they bond over their shared love for their favorite idol! And under certain conditions, they agree to live together in order to help him make a comeback...!? For the sake of her favorite idol, she'll make him return! The comeback cohabitation comedy with her idol's neighbor begins!!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title.native: イカすゥせぇるすまん

title.english: That Time I Made My Hot Tutor My Pet

220077.description:
Katayama-kun is a picky eater through and through. But when Mikoru Iinuma, a cheerful, athletic beauty, starts feeding him during lunch break, he finds himself in absolute agony!! During their high school lunch breaks, can food bring these two—who would otherwise never cross paths—closer together!? Katayama-kun's otherwise uneventful youth is about to be spiced up with a dangerously excessive helping of nutrition...!!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.native: 死に戻り令嬢はピュアな悪妻です 今世では幸せになりましょう旦那様
title.romaji: Shi ni Modori Reijou wa Pure na Akusai desu Imayo de wa Shiawase ni Narimashou Danna-sama

220081.description:
There are as many tears as there are cats. Encounters. Farewells. And reunions. Cats and humans (us) have lived together, now and in the past, in this world and the next.

With over 1.2 million likes in total, the short manga "Slanted-Eyed Cat," which caused a huge sensation on X, is finally being published in full color. Includes 12 pages of new illustrations! Plenty of stories just about cats!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

220082.description:
"Moe no Chi" follows a girl troubled by her appearance as she searches for her long-lost mother. "Kaijuutachi no Iru Tokoro" delves into a massive scandal involving a mascot character. "Ashiwoarau" tells the story of a boy who aspires to be a yakuza on the very day he leaves the gang. "Dai 6 no ibasho" sees a boy returning home after 11 years to find his hometown transformed into an "overly wholesome town." A collection of emo and punk short stories that kick society with outlandish humor.

(Source: Kobunsha, translated)
synonyms: The Blood of Moe: Aki Yoshika's Short Story Collection

title.native: 萌えの血　秋ヨシカ作品集
title.romaji: Moe no Chi: Aki Yoshika Sakuhinshuu

title.romaji: Kinjo no Anoko to, Pants na Kankei

title.native: ご奉仕メイド霊に取り憑かれました!

220087.description:
Kim Minjae was the apple of his chaebol family's eye. However, his grandfather's company went bankrupt, and Minjae died coughing up blood in a corner of a cramped one room flat. Opening his eyes upon returning to when he was 17 years old, Minjae finds that he can see people's personal profiles...! A second chance has arrived like a miracle. Now, Kim Minjae knows. Who the traitors are, and who the loyal subjects are!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: The Chaebol Heir Who Takes It All

220088.description:
Akika Izumi, an office worker at a merchandise production company, had a problem. Her mail and trash at home were being rummaged through, and she felt like someone was watching her—yes, her problem was the presence of a stalker. Thinking that telling anyone would only cause trouble, Izumi couldn't confide in anyone, but during a drinking party with her boss, Daiki Asano, she ended up telling him. To Izumi's regret, Asano surprisingly suggested that they pretend to be her boyfriend! Asano promised to protect her more than anyone else and solve the stalker problem, but he actually has a shocking secret...!?

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title.native: 頼れる上司は控えめに言ってもヤバい人でした。
title.romaji: Tayoreru Joushi wa Hikaeme ni Itte mo Yabaihito deshita

220089.description:
A Russian manga artist brings you a suspenseful one-shot about life and money!! There is no escaping the cutthroat world of capitalism. In desperate need of a large sum of money to survive, can Emil risk everything to secure a tomorrow for himself?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: ドッジファイター一撃!

220091.description:
Is this Hell or Heaven? Welcome to the world of Noboru Yoshimi!

Contains three manga:
1. A! Seimeisen ga Kireteiru (あっ！生命線が切れている)
2. Noroi no Handbag (呪いのハンドバック)
3. Youkai Shichi Henge (妖怪七変化)

title.native: あっ!生命線が切れている

220093.description:
Kyouko Kizuka is the daughter of a servant who works for the Tadokoro family. She looks exactly like Ruriko, the Tadokoro family’s young lady—both in age and appearance—with the only difference being a mole under Ruriko’s left eye. However, there’s a world of difference in how they’re treated. On top of that, Ruriko is spiteful and vain, and she uses Kyouko however she pleases. One day, after Ruriko loses a game of badminton to Kyouko, Ruriko proposes that they switch places for a day. On that day, Ruriko dies in an accident while still dressed as Kyouko. Having finally attained the life she’d always longed for, Kyouko tries her best to become Ruriko. However, Ruriko’s vengeful spirit appears and starts to torment her.

(Source: Kaiki Manga no Anagura, translated)

220094.description:
The stubborn, hyper-competitive top student Chu Xun, who has to be the best his whole life, just happens to run into Su Muqing, a genius girl who can read minds. He's determined to become the number one student in the entire school!

It's here! The Top Student System has arrived! Chu Xun's learning ability is going up! Up! Up!

But... why do the system's tasks feel so much like... dating?!

And so... Classmate Su's affection level goes up~ up~ up~
synonyms: My Academic System Is Making Me Date?!

title.native: 尽管是学霸系统，但小苏同学的好感度在稳步提升
title.romaji: Jinguan Shi Xueba Xitong, Dan Xiao Su Tongxue de Haogan Du Zai Wenbu Tisheng

220095.description:
Qi An accepted the mission solely to make up for his failure to protect the Gao family, unaware that the person he was tasked with protecting was none other than the “Boy Behind the Flower Wall” from all those years ago. The burn scars on Gao Jinwan’s back and his pathological craving for eye contact reminded Qi An of his first love; meanwhile, the predatory gaze beneath Qi An’s tight-fitting mask, a gaze that sent shivers down his spine, continued to ignite Gao Jinwan’s desire.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Fushi no Dungeon Master: Uragirare Suterareta Teihen Boukensha ga Moto Nakama no Onna Boukenshatachi ni Wakarase Fukushuu wo Chikaimasu!

220103.description:
Russtis, one of the Seven Great Sword Saints with the all-seeing divine skill "Divine Eye," had retired from the front lines for certain reasons and was enjoying a slow life in the countryside. One day, he was summoned to the capital to give an update on his current situation, and his fate changed completely when he saved a wandering girl named Satie from danger! She then asked him to take her on as her apprentice. After that, more and more girls with divine skills started gathering around him—!?

(Source: Comic Gardo, translated)
synonyms: The Relatively Peaceful Daily Life of a Supporting Character Sword Saint. Occasionally, Adventures and Heroic Tales

title.native: 脇役剣聖のそこそこ平穏な日常。たまに冒険、そして英雄譚。
title.romaji: Wakiyaku Kensei no Sokosoko Heion na Nichijou. Tama ni Bouken, Soshite Eiyuutan.

220104.description:
The only reason he is the strongest is... effort!! Ichitarou, a high school boy, has a personality that causes him to get completely absorbed in a single task. One day, his entire class is transported to another world as heroes. The hero rank assigned to him at his destination is the worst. Deemed a useless existence, Ichitarou gets locked away in a prison where time is stopped. There, he devotes himself to 100 million years of training. By the time he leaves the prison, he has mastered each and every swordsmanship style and become the ultimate hero!!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: The Unaware Sword Saint Who Trained for 1,000,000,000,000 Years

title.native: 一億年修行の無自覚剣聖〜ただの棒だと馬鹿にされた万能の神器と、極限の修行で生み出した『剣鬼』の人格で異世界を圧倒する〜
title.romaji: Ichiokunen Shugyou no Mujikaku Kensei: Tada no Bou da to Baka ni Sareta Bannou no Jingi to, Kyokugen no Shugyou de Umidashita "Kenki" no Jinkaku de Isekai wo Attousuru

title.romaji: Ore no Ushiro no Kanojo ga Joui Sonzai Sugiru

title.native: 次期魔王に転生したボク、禁忌スキル『エナジードレイン』で魔族無双します

220112.description:
When the warrior Hamel sacrifices himself to protect his rival Bermut Lionhart, he makes Bermut vow to vanquish the last of the demon kings. Reincarnated with his memories 300 years later, he is shocked to find that not only are the demon kings still alive, but that he has been reborn as Eugene Lionhart, a member of his former rival’s bloodline! Now, as Eugene comes of age, he must train to prove himself as a Lionhart and eliminate the remaining demon kings once and for all.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Third season of Bireomeogeul Hwansaeng.

synonyms: A Fake Marriage at a British Antique Shop

title.native: 英国骨董店がらくた偽装結婚
転生したらポンコツメイドと呼ばれていました 前世のあれこれを持ち込みお屋敷改革します

220115.description:
In the bizarre city of Belcraft, there lives a cat named Archimedes who works for a building maintenance company, and his junior, Othello, a self-proclaimed planet manager android. In this town full of mysterious structures, can they get through each job without incident? Peek into the daily lives of this peculiar pair!

(Source: Yen Press)

220122.description:
Leonard receives a small favor from a woman he has just met. He decides to return the kindness, but he has no idea what that "repayment" will actually entail. As it turns out, what she wants in return is this: “This is the man I’ve promised to marry!” He is about to find himself bound to her for the rest of his life. Irenea Blair. After losing her parents, she was exploited by her uncle—only to eventually lose her own life as well. Or so it seemed—yet, she has returned to a time before everything was taken from her. This time, she will not let anything be stolen away. And there is something else, too—something she must reclaim at all costs. Her heartless knight—the one who broke his promise never to die and leave her behind. "This time, I will be the one to protect you. So that you never lose a single thing."

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: In Return, I Will Ask You to Marry Me!

220123.description:
A defeated demon lord is revived in the modern world. Alfreed, descendent of the hero who defeated him long ago, is our only hope...except he has no powers. Three girls are chosen to protect him, but there's a catch—all three of them want to be the hero's future bride! Pack your bags for an epic adventure in which our hero defeats the demon lord...if his three protectors don't annoy him to death first!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

220132.description:
Ten years after the Tower of Infinity appeared across the world, Lee Kanghan, a man with a peculiar constitution that gave him a muscular physique just by sleeping, awakened as the Heavenly Demon.

[Heavenly Demonic Physique (Rank: F–SSS)]

But something about the ranking seemed off.

"Is this… actually weak?"

…As if that were possible.

[Notice: Player "Lee Kanghan" has achieved the "World's First S-Rank" achievement.]

[Notice: Player "Lee Kanghan" has achieved the "World's First...]

The weak ones were his opponents... for they were the enemies of the Heavenly Demon.

(Source: Toyou's Dream Website, translated)
synonyms: The Heavenly Demon Wrecks the Tower

220133.description:
The story centers on a girl who reincarnates into a medieval fantasy world as Lilina, the sole heiress of noble county title. Once Lilina's grandfather passes away, she immediately inherits the title, and makes her debut into aristocratic society. Contrary to her expectations, her attempts at finding a suitor from other nobles is unsuccessful. When a handsome duke shows interest in Lilina, she suspects that he is simply asking for marriage to ward off any further annoying proposals, but it turns out the duke is sweet to her.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: 転生伯爵リリーナの結婚~イケメン公爵様の虫除け係!?~

220134.description: Ryoko was playing with a walkie-talkie given to her by her grandfather. Suddenly, she heard the voice of her grandfather, who was supposed to be dead...!? Ryoko suspects it's some kind of AI, but is told to go to her grandfather's room. What she finds when she goes to the back of the room is...!?

220135.description:
Florence, Italy, in the 15th century. Late in life, Leonardo da Vinci, an artist blessed with rare beauty and talent, left behind the words "I never succeeded." In Florence, the City of Flowers, where desire, inferiority and jealousy swirl, what was the "success" da Vinci sought? A new frontier for Kiyo Kyujyo, creator of "ZONE-00", depicting the troubled da Vinci in delicate, aesthetic linework.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Mumu, a boy raised in the mountains with monstrous strength, enters the prestigious Martial Arts Academy. He knows nothing of martial arts, politics, or the deadly schemes of the noble clans. But when you can crush boulders with your bare hands, how much does technique really matter?

(Source: Naver, translated)

220175.description:
Akashi Yuri, a rookie teacher, endures hectic days, and her only solace is reading doujinshi BL (Boys' Love). One day, she notices that her favorite author, who is working as a booth attendant at a comic convention, resembles her boss, the vice-principal... The ultimate fan-focused adventure begins in the high school staff room!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 腐男子教頭は隠したい。

220176.description:
Nightingale, Cleopatra, Murasaki Shikibu, Dakki, Marie Curie, Thatcher...etc. They've all been reincarnated, and they're all sexually aggressive! It's crazy!! These great women are plump and sexy! The protagonist is a handsome, sensible guy with an incredible... thing...and he's the manager of the dormitory where they live! The most erotic, tease-and-deny manga in history!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

220177.description:
In 2040, when VR full-dive technology has become a reality, the cyberspace "Reverse," which people had only dreamed of, has become a cesspool for the "have-nots." Seita Tachibana is a failing college student holed up in "Reverse," diligently searching for a job. Then, he gets caught up in a terrorist incident that occurs within "Reverse." Moreover, among the members claiming to be the masterminds is his twin brother, Mizuki, who was supposed to be dead...!? And what is the truth hidden behind the birth of "Reverse"? A new kind of near-future VR suspense!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

The time is the Meiji era(1868~1912) and as Japan is in midst of major changes away from the old ways, a police officer with a fondness for this new way of thinking is ready to take the stage by storm!

220191.description:
Stacy climbed her way up to the top of the church as a powerful saintess—but in a male-dominated society, her cruel father just sees her as marriage material for political gain. Tired of being treated like a pawn, she comes up with a solution: a list of 8 unreasonable, non-negotiable, and self-indulgent conditions for any potential husband. That way, no one will possibly qualify, and she’ll be happily single...right?

Until one day, someone actually steps forward claiming he meets every requirement—the King himself?!

What started as a half-serious "perfect husband" checklist turns into a royal engagement!

(Source: Manga UP!)

Matsuri Tanaka is the second-generation member of the new religious movement "Yuni-kyo." Matsuri never considered defying her devout mother, but one day, she is attacked by a mysterious monster! This monster is none other than "Yuni-kami." Just as she prepares for death, a powerful urge for food wells up within her…

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Let's attend class in an alternate world. ♥♥ (Source: Fakku)

220200.description:
A meeting with the Demon King's mother changes the destiny of the weakest boy. An exhilarating, super-pampered & peerless revenge story begins! Solo, a dull boy who grew up without knowing his mother, joins his childhood friend's hero party to defeat the Demon King! But after returning to the kingdom in triumph, the hero betrays Solo, casting him into the depths of despair!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

220201.description:
Junpei Iguchi (25), an office worker, finds himself burdened with massive debt after failing at cryptocurrency investments. His chosen side hustle? Surprisingly, it's... a therapist for women! And to make matters worse, he carries a trauma stemming from his ex-girlfriend... Now begins "JUNPEI's" adventure as a therapist, exploring the depths of female sexuality (without actual intercourse)!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

220204.description:
"It's just the two of us again today." The mysterious and somewhat quirky daily lives of Chicago 671, a duo of idols with a 12-year career. This is the new standard for idol manga.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: いっしょにいちゃおっか
りのちゃんの好きなこと

220207.description:
On the coast of Hakodate, Itsumi - a girl playing the trumpet alone, the instrument she learned from her grandfather - encounters "real jazz" on her first visit to Tokyo. Then, the stage shifts to high school. Together with her friends in the jazz club she founded, she sets her sights on the world from her port town!!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

220208.description: A romantic comedy following the everyday lives of a cold-hearted working snake and a skunk girl who is a livestreamer. The two agree to pretend to be a couple, but their relationship gradually develops into something more genuine.

220214.description:
For Junya Inumaru, who grew up at the foot of a snowy mountain, snowboarding was just a normal form of "fun." That's what he thought, until he met that man... A story of passionate play turning a hobby into a passionate life! A thrilling sports coming-of-age tale!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

220215.description:
Hashiba Miko, a first-year high school student, lives peacefully with her mother and younger brother despite their poverty. One day, she receives a suspicious direct message on her smartphone promising to earn over 1 million yen a month by registering for a game. Miko initially ignores it, but her mother collapses from overwork and passes away, and her brother is hospitalized. To save her brother's life, Miko starts playing the pay-to-play game "Magical Girl Live!". However, what awaits her is a dangerous "game" where money and lives are at stake! Can she earn a fortune and survive?!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

220216.description:
In a long life, countless predicaments arise. That's why sometimes it's important to "run away"... The daily life of Ittetsu Takada, the vice-principal and student guidance counselor at a public high school, is a series of crises unique to middle management. Vice-principal Takada, who takes pride in his earnest and unwavering way of life, tries to get through each situation in his own way, but this is where the "negative chain reaction" that begins ends up creating a hilarious, or rather, chaotic scene in the staff room... This is a gag manga like that!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

220220.description:
"Sensei, I just want to die..." "Why don't you get married?" Tsukimi, a hikikomori suffering from depression, an eating disorder, and social anxiety, begins her search for a husband! Despite setbacks and being ripped off, Tsukimi continues her search. Will she recover from her illness and finally get married?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: ウツ婚！！ 死にたい私が生き延びるための婚活
title.romaji: Utsu Kon!! Shinitai Watashi ga Ikinobiru Tame no Konkatsu

220221.description:
Akira (21), a beautiful woman with high potential but who consistently "misses" everything she tries. Her cool younger sister, Nozomi (15), wants to help her sister. The sisters live a life of poverty due to the debt left behind by their father, but on the night of the full moon, they decide to "play" with Nozomi's ability. That ability is to "come up with numbers that 'hit' something." These numbers don't lead to instant riches... but they still bring happiness to someone. Thus, they gradually fill their town with happiness, and one day it might even reach the moon... the endearing days of these lucky sisters!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

220222.description:
A heartwarming story about a cute brother and sister living in Sugamo. The sister, Onei, and the brother, Junichiro, are twins. Their parents are often away, so they are raised by their mother's friends and neighbors. A heartwarming full-color comic!!

(Source: Shonen Gahosha, translated)

220226.description:
Philip, a servant of the Hester family, faithfully served his master, his wife, and their family. Through a very coincidental turn of events, he comes to feel that the eldest son of the household has suddenly been born. Caught between a sense of alienation and loyalty, Philip spends his days in turmoil; however, when he is chosen as a attendant to the eldest son, Ivan, and begins to serve him closely, his daily life is thrown into chaos. Philip constantly doubts whether Ivan is the 'real' young master. Yet, as he observes Ivan's actions, he increasingly reproaches himself for having doubted him. Just as Philip lets his guard down around Ivan, a certain incident forces him to confront the true nature that Ivan has been hiding...!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
